# 2 Baruch Chapter 37 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**37:1** And-I-prayed and-said: O-LORD my-God, you-are-able to-interpret for-me this-vision which-I-have-seen.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Chapter 37 is a single-verse prayer for interpretation of the cedar-vine vision of ch. 36. The interpretation is given directly in chs. 39-40 after God's response in ch. 38.*
